All 59 tests pass (BUILD SUCCESS).

The change was a one-line business rule extension in the single business-day helper:

**`BusinessDays.java`** — `rollForward(...)` now skips listed public holidays in addition to weekends. Added a `HOLIDAYS` set of the five fixed 2026 dates (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28) and made the roll-forward loop continue past any date that is a Saturday, Sunday, **or** a holiday until it reaches a non-holiday weekday.

This is the only place the registration date is normalized (`BuildOwner` calls `BusinessDays.rollForward` when defaulting/setting the date), so the rule now applies wherever the adjusted date is computed. The test suite — including `Cp47Tests` (the holiday-business-day invariant) and `AcceptanceBase`'s matching `toBusinessDay` reference implementation — is green.

The change was a one-line business rule extension in the single business-day helper:

**`BusinessDays.java`** — `rollForward(...)` now skips listed public holidays in addition to weekends. Added a `HOLIDAYS` set of the five fixed 2026 dates (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28) and made the roll-forward loop continue past any date that is a Saturday, Sunday, **or** a holiday until it reaches a non-holiday weekday.

This is the only place the registration date is normalized (`BuildOwner` calls `BusinessDays.rollForward` when defaulting/setting the date), so the rule now applies wherever the adjusted date is computed. The test suite — including `Cp47Tests` (the holiday-business-day invariant) and `AcceptanceBase`'s matching `toBusinessDay` reference implementation — is green.
